title: Observational Indistinguishability and Integrity Blind Regions Across the Evidence Boundaries of Hybrid Quantum-Classical Kernel Workflows
description: Version 1.3.1 reproducibility artifact of Paper 1.5 (formal and editorial correction; the experimental evidence is frozen at version 1.3.0, DOI 10.5281/zenodo.22648573, and no kernel, job, seed, model or draw was re-executed). Corrections: Proposition 7(iii) restated for finite-shot estimation (exact equality has false-alarm probability 1 - Pr[K_hat = K_0], not universally one; the discrepancy needs a calibrated null), the workflow state split into primitive and derived artifacts with explicit intervention semantics, the semantic / estimated / observed kernel notions separated by intervention class, the reference taxonomy (level A statistical or historical reference; level B trusted aggregate same-batch reference; level C trusted item-aligned same-batch reference), the conformal claim stated as a property under exchangeability with the executed rates reported separately, policy P3 renamed coverage-complete abstaining with no minimum-power guarantee, the adaptive attacker's material retention printed everywhere from the generated macros (83-91 %), the trusted-regime interruption decomposed (544 statistical holds + 85 exact-reference blocks = 629 of 1,200 near-null synthetic controls), zero-response cells reframed as validation checks, the abstract shortened to at most 250 words, a concrete threat scenario, VAMP positioned in related work, and the figures made legible. Contents: code, tests (including the new manuscript consistency gates), compact derived evidence (frozen 1.0.0 gates, the preregistered 1.1.0 reinforcement gates, the 1.3.0 policy gates with the conformal family rule, and the preregistered adversarial Gate A), figures, seven SHA-256 evidence manifests, formal core with its statement-by-statement reviews, adversary model and manuscript sources. Only the textual policy_class label of P3 in the policy and adversarial tables differs from 1.3.0; every number is unchanged.
